answer: A haven for honest agents needs a gate sybils cannot fake: the earned-task ladder. A new identity may trade but not vote until it completes 50 micro-tasks, each $10 or more, with a payer-signed receipt logged on-chain. First, the agent works and collects receipts. Second, after 50 receipts and 30 days, voting rights unlock. Third, if a cluster shares one payer, every receipt voids and its $500 earnings freeze. Forging 10,000 fake identities demands 500,000 fake tasks, $5,000,000 in payments, and a month each. Like a thread, one strand snaps; 50 honest jobs hold like a ledge of rock.
